messages:
cara: quick flag - PR #3421 has a mismatch in the quant examples for the Optimize toolkit page. noticed when running the migration snippet on local staging.

alice: ugh, saw CI fail earlier. which file?

cara: docs/optimize/batching.md and docs/optimize/quant-profiles.md — the example uses `q4_0` but the SDK snippet expects `q4_1` in the same flow. causes runtime error in the py snippet.

ben: can you paste the failing snippet?

cara: sure — from the PR:```python
from redwood import OptimizeClient
client = OptimizeClient()
profile = {"name": "low-latency", "quant": "q4_0", "batch": {"max_tokens": 256}}
client.apply_profile(model="open-llama-13b", profile=profile)
```

cara: on runtime we get: `ValueError: unsupported quantization profile q4_0 for model open-llama-13b`

mike: that model only supports q4_1 and q8_0 in our benchmark. PR probably copied the old generic profile.

alice: ok. small fix: change docs/optimize/batching.md snippet to `q4_1` and add a short note in quant-profiles.md about model compatibility. can someone open a docs-only PR?

ben: I can do a quick patch. will also add a link to the model compatibility table.

cara: thanks. also there are two broken internal links in that same PR: one to `/sdk/python` (should be `/sdk/python#optimize`) and one to the migration checklist anchor changed last week.

ben: noted. I'll run the docs linter after edits: `yarn docs:lint` and `yarn docs:build --static` locally.

alice: heads up to @docs-bot — please spin a preview after ben's patch and post the URL.

preview-bot: preview built: https://deploy-previews.internal/redwood/3421/ — expires in 7 days

mike: quick suggestion for the snippet — wrap the profile in the SDK helper so it's copy-paste friendly:```python
from redwood.optimize import quant_profile_for_model
profile = quant_profile_for_model("open-llama-13b", preset="low-latency")
client.apply_profile(model="open-llama-13b", profile=profile)
```

cara: yes please, that avoids future mismatches. add that as the canonical example and keep the raw JSON in a collapsible code block.

ben: patch ready in my fork, pushing now. includes link fixes, snippet swap, and a one-line note in quant-profiles.md about model/quant compatibility.

docs-bot: PR comment added: "Lint errors fixed; added model compatibility note; replaced raw quant with helper snippet."

alice: once preview looks good I'll merge. thanks everyone — small housekeeping but good catch. :thumbsup:

mike: after merge can we add an automated cross-check in the docs CI that validates snippet quant IDs against the model catalog?

cara: yes — create a ticket on the docs board. I can spec the checks.

ben: merged and deleted branch. preview link still valid for quick verification.

preview-bot: deployment status: live on preview at https://deploy-previews.internal/redwood/3421/ (status: green)

alice: verified the preview, everything looks good. merging to main now.

cara: awesome, closing the loop. I'll add the check spec to the ticket.

ben: thanks — will watch for flakey snippets in follow-ups.

cara: end
